verified_facts.text: Banyan Tree Mayakoba is an all-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba, with direct access to the Caribbean coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Mayakoba is an all-private-pool villa resort set within the protected mangroves and freshwater lagoons of Mayakoba, offering direct access to the Caribbean coast.

verified_facts.text: Every villa and suite has a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every accommodation features a private pool and spacious outdoor living areas, offering exceptional privacy and comfort.

verified_facts.text: The resort blends local Mexican traditions and hospitality with Asian culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: local traditions and hospitality meet Asian culture and wisdom in a true Sanctuary for the Senses.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a white-sand beachfront that guests can use for swimming and snorkeling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto soft, powdery sands and enjoy exclusive access to our serene beachfront—perfect for swimming, snorkeling, or simply soaking up the sun with a cocktail in hand.

verified_facts.text: The Lagoon & Sunset Rooftop Pool Villa is a two-storey over-the-water villa steps from the white-sand beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find tranquility in this stunning two-storey, over-the-water villa, just steps from the white-sand beach.

verified_facts.text: In the Family Residences, a rooftop solarium has a pool overlooking the golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooftop solarium, with its pool overlooking the stunning golf course, provides a serene escape surrounded by nature.

verified_facts.text: The Serenity Pool Villa with Living Room has Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: natural hues, complemented with splashes of color and Talavera-glazed earthenware sinks, will remind you of your Caribbean surroundings.

verified_facts.text: The Bliss Pool Villa uses natural materials such as wood, wicker and ceramic inside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, natural materials like wood, wicker, and ceramic provide a sense of home

verified_facts.text: The spa's pavilions and suites reflect local Mexican heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed pavilions and suites reflect local Mexican heritage while embracing the beauty of the Riviera Maya.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a Temazcal ritual, an ancient Mesoamerican ceremony led by a shaman inside a sacred dome with volcanic stones and healing herbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reconnect with Mother Earth through the ancient Mesoamerican ritual of Temazcal. Led by a shaman inside a sacred dome, volcanic stones and healing herbs guide this deeply purifying journey

verified_facts.text: The spa's Rainforest is a hydrothermal experience inspired by Asian and European healing traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rainforest is a complete hydrothermal experience inspired by the healing traditions of Asia and Europe.

verified_facts.text: Spa therapists are trained at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy in Phuket.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our therapists are trained at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy in Phuket

verified_facts.text: Saffron is the resort's signature Thai restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Key resort features include signature Thai dining at Saffron and holistic treatments at the Banyan Tree Spa.

verified_facts.text: Ixchel serves breakfast or dinner aboard a traditional Mexican trajinera floating through the waterways.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a unique culinary journey on a traditional Mexican Trajinera, floating through waterways while savoring breakfast or a remarkable dinner in the moonlight.

verified_facts.text: A complimentary ecotour through the canals offers sightings of wildlife such as birds, turtles and crocodiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Mayakoba’s beauty on a complimentary ecotour through scenic canals. Glide past lush landscapes, while spotting local wildlife like birds, turtles, and crocodiles.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary bicycles let guests ride through jungle trails, along canals and to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ride through lush jungle trails, along scenic canals, and toward the beach or your next dining spot

verified_facts.text: Mayakoba has a cenote called Burrodromo that is exclusive to Mayakoba guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here in Mayakoba, we have a cenote called Burródromo, exclusive for Mayakoba guests.

verified_facts.text: Mayakoba's three-mile nature trail winds through mangroves and lagoons, with bird-watching towers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The path winds through mangroves and lagoons, with rest areas and bird-watching towers offering peaceful spots.

verified_facts.text: Rotating wellness practices include Sunrise Yoga, SUP stretching and Shinrin Yoku forest bathing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Mayakoba offers a variety of rotating wellness practices, including Sunrise Yoga, Mindful Pilates, UP Core & Balance, SUP (Stand-Up Paddleboard) Stretching, Shinrin Yoku (forest bathing), and Duo Yoga

verified_facts.text: El Camaleon, the Greg Norman-designed 18-hole golf course, runs through greenery, freshwater canals, mangroves and seaside views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Greg Norman, El Camaleón offers a challenging 18-hole layout through lush greenery, freshwater canals, mangroves, and seaside views.

verified_facts.text: The Kid's Club is located at Sands Beach Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Kid’s Club, located at our Sands Beach Club, is the most fun-filled corner of Banyan Tree Mayakoba.

verified_facts.text: The resort is a 20-minute drive from downtown Playa del Carmen.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are a 20-minute drive from downtown Playa del Carmen

verified_facts.text: At night, Saffron, Cello, Tomahawk and Sands Beach Club recommend elegant-casual attire, and beach shorts and flip-flops are not permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: At night: Saffron, Cello, Tomahawk Open Fire Latin Grill, Sands Beach Club: Elegant-casual attire is recommended. Beach shorts and flip-flops are not permitted.

verified_facts.text: Small dogs and cats can be accommodated.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are happy to accommodate small dogs and cats weighing up to 22 pounds at Banyan Tree Mayakoba.
